notes.title: Early Access Patch Notes #4: Final Event, Base Upgrades & Strategic Survival
notes.notes:
CARAVAN BASE
Managing a group of survivors after the collapse is a tough challenge, but with the new features in this patch, you can spend days expanding your base – your safe haven. Build a mobile mini-town, becoming an independent entity, where, as the leader (Prophet), you decide who deserves to stay safe within your walls and who must be banished from the base.
The Medical Care and Medical Supplies system has been reworked. Now players can donate medical consumables to gain Medical Supplies. Medical Care value can only be increased by specific structure, currently the Infirmaries.
Redesigned rations panel for followers management.
Sick and medical supply management system.
Now players can assign workers to Infirmary structures that will boost Medical Care value. 
New upgrade options for all production structures, infirmaries, and workshops.
Followers banishment system (remove followers from your base/caravan).
New crafting components.


BATTLE
Molotov cocktail - a new craftable weapon. Surprise your enemies with fire!
Molotov cocktail research project has been added to the munitions research tree.
Ability Targeting system has been added. You can now choose whether to target yourself or your companions while using consumable class items during battle.
Redesigned Stress Points allocation mechanic.

INVENTORY
You can now select multiple items and move them between windows or characters. No more tedious single clicks, try out the Ctrl feature!

CAMPING IN HOUSES
The player can now camp during scavenging in households, but beware! Even if you don’t use camping supplies, there's always a risk of ambush after camping in a building. Choose wisely and manage your resources and risks when deciding where to sleep.

STORYLINE
Main story markers (exclamation points) have appeared on the World Map. These are not required to complete Early Access, but the knowledge gained will help you better understand the circumstances of your battles and the world around you, preparing you for the final showdown.

FINAL EVENT
This event concludes the Early Access story, revealing your main enemy and testing whether you're ready to dive deeper into the world of Interregnum. Take on the challenge, gather resources and companions, and prepare for the ultimate battle before continuing your journey through the post-apocalyptic frozen California. 
Will you fulfill your role as the Prophet and lead your followers to the promised land?

GENERAL
We've implemented further optimizations and fixes, including AI improvements in battles and on the World Map, as well as bug fixes, including those on battle maps.
We apologize for any inconvenience and appreciate your support!

notes.title: Early Access Patch Notes #3: Explorer Mode now available!
notes.notes:
[b]NOTE:[/b] This update may break old saves, so making a new one is recommended! We apologize for the inconvenience.

[h1]WHAT'S NEW?[/h1]

[h2]GENERAL[/h2]

[list]
[*] [b]Explorer mode has been enabled![/b] Save anywhere on the world map to continue your pilgrimage later.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43204374/a5f59fd8ae76865946e58c9d8be0027932dcccc3.jpg[/img]

[h2]WORLD MAP[/h2]

[list]
[*] Anomalous Essence has been added as collectible to the world map along with its spawning mechanics (Be careful to not slip on the ice!)
[*] Survivor Camps have been added as interactive objects on the map
[*] Weapons and armors now can be found with over 50 tags that modify their stats. (You can find items with up to 3 tags! Good luck with looting)
[*] 8 New melee weapons have been added to the game
[*] New camping option has been added - Houses. Now the player is able to make a camp during scavenging process in households
[/list]

[h2]CARAVAN BASE[/h2]

[list]
[*] Research system has been implemented. Research is performed by workshops and allows you to unlock new crafting recipes, structures and truck modules. All already constructed structures and modules, along with all recipes unlocked before the update will be automatically be marked as researched in the technology trees.
[*] A new structure has been added - Upgrade Station. The upgrade station allows you to improve stats of both weapons and clothes. Unlocked by research.
[/list]


[h1]ADJUSTMENTS[/h1]

[h2]BATTLE[/h2]

[list]
[*] Fixed crash after DeadShelter battle on AMD Gpu
[*] Improved colors and lighting on battle maps
[*] Optimization of the first battle map
[*] Fixed spawn points to match amount of players and enemies
[*] AI behavior has been improved for all of the enemies
[*] Armor and penetration stats bugs have been fixed and their functionality got rebalanced
[*] Aiming along with Line of Sight visualizations got rebalanced. Now the color more accurately represents the chances to hit the target. Be sure to choose more suitable aim level, before shooting at inefficient range!
[*] AI animations were re-adjusted to improve the immersion
[*] New floating texts were added
[*] Improved the visual of the bullet traces
[*] Fixed the damage issues with the shotgun pellets (Now it should have a punch!)
[*] Fixed AI blocking the movement paths bug
[*] Ranged weapons shooting sounds overhaul
[*] Fixed last bullet dealing default bullet type damage
[*] Fixed characters aiming animations
[/list]

[h2]WORLD MAP[/h2]

[list]
[*] Fixed crash caused by skipping the first cutscene on the worldmap
[*] Improved character rendering window in Inventory
[*] Optimizations of worldmap
[*] Added inventory floating text notification
[*] Updated the UI visuals and functionality for the repair kits
[*] Fixed click-through bug interface elements
[*] Updated the visuals of floating texts
[*] Improved audio of the camp
[*] User Interface sounds improvements
[*] Fixed TakeAll moving items to characters left in base
[*] Fixed disappearing ammo when loading directly to weapon already loaded with different type
[*] Fixed minor mesh clipping in inventory
[/list]

[h2]CARAVAN BASE[/h2]

[list]
[*] Added appearance randomization of tent structures.
[/list]

[h2]EVENTS AND CUTSCENES[/h2]

[list]
[*] Lowered global challenge difficulty
[*] Fixed leftover demo option in wandering band events
[*] Fixed bug preventing recruitment from wandering bands
[*] Fixed blank icons bug in the events
[*] Replaced some of the icons for visual clarity
[/list]

[h2]GENERAL[/h2]

[list]
[*] Fixed start-up audio bug
[/list]

notes.title: Early Access Patch Notes #1
notes.notes:
Hey there! Thanks everyone for your feedback, it was incredibly helpful! We've prepared a nice set of patch notes for you, full of bugfixes!

[h1]BATTLE[/h1]

[list]
[*] Fixed LoS for AI resulting in erratic movement and rare shooting.
[*] Fixed double barrel SG collision resulting in character flying when walking over.
[*] Fixed AP calculations resulting in unlimited ap exploit when shooting.
[*] Fixed melee bug freezing turns after being interrupted.
[*] Fixed traits/statuses regarding AP and shooting.
[*] Fixed items showing in ability description.
[*] Added new AI behaviours for military.
[*] Tweaked AI engaging resulting in more natural behaviour
[*] Added visual info about enemy unable to move due to lack of AP.
[*] Added visual info about resisting guard deactivation by getting hit.
[*] Added guard close proximity detection.
[*] Improved enemy turn timeout and reduced timer to 8s.
[*] Removed camera return on shooting finish.
[*] Fixed camera occlusions still visible on battle summary
[*] New grenade explosion vfx
[*] Improved lighting on the first battle
[*] Fixed military voice over.
[*] New Interruption round and basic round frame visuals
[*] Adjusted ammo penetration
[/list]

[h1]WORLD MAP[/h1]

[list]
[*] Fixed navigation issues in SunkenCity area
[*] Fixed skyscrapers in SunkenCity
[*] Fixed an issue where morale would reset to 0 while driving the caravan.
[*] Fixed an issue where morale events would create an infinite loop.
[*] Fixed an issue where caravan events would appear while driving.
[*] Fixed an issue where Battle Loot on worldmap could lose items inside container.
[*] Fixed an issue where some Random Encounters were empty and did not play their events.
[*] Fixed an issue where buildings would sometimes play Random Encounter events before looting.
[*] Fixed an issue where Random Encounters and Anomalies would spawn duplicates in the same position.
[*] Improved randomization of Random Encounters and Anomalies to prevent duplication and enhance variety.
[*] Grain can now be used in the campfire pot
[*] Updated movement tooltips
[*] Updated survival reactions to show portrait overlays
[*] Food poisoning bug fixed
[*] Added item dismantling
[/list]

[h1]EVENTS AND CUTSCENES[/h1]

[list]
[*] Fixed not visible hilltop roof during 2nd cutscene
[*] Fixed Caravan cutscene audio timing.
[*] Fog was removed from Hilltop interior
[*] Challenge panel visuals and UI animation tweaks
[/list]

[h1]CARAVAN BASE[/h1]

[list]
[*] Added new sounds for building management in Caravan Base mode.
[*] Party members name frame should no longer stay visible after activating a conversation event.
[*] Contribution Crate panel behavior tweaks - it is no longer be possible to exit the base if the crate is not empty.
[*] Implemented Donate context option. Available only in the Caravan Base. On click, opens contribution crate panel and automatically transfers the context item to the crate's inventory.
[*] Many context options tweaks. Some context options were available even though the conditions to run them were not met, like dismantle or equip, which caused their usage to do nothing. This has been fixed.
[*] Small tent and shelter max tenants capacity has been lowered. Currently build tents will remain unaffected by this change.
[*] Fixed a bug that caused some structures to show level 1 stats after re-entering the base, even though they were upgraded before.
[*] Now dismantling structures requires player's confirmation.
[*] Swapping characters for crafting in the caravan hotfix
[/list]

[h1]GENERAL[/h1]

[list]
[*] UI sounds improvements.
[*] Audio balance tweaks.
[*] Other small bugfixes
[/list]


Thank you so much for playing the game! We hope this new patch makes it more enjoyable for you. We're always considering your feedback, finding and fixing new bugs, and working on the game, so expect more of these as time goes on!
